conversation_pain_points: bot did not use plain language
bot did not answer prognosis question directly
bot overloaded user with medication names

main_topics.reason: Opening question and the repeated 'will I feel like this forever' return to prognosis drove the conversation.
User asked what can be done and how to get medications, over many turns.
User described hurting all over, worst in mornings in hands, shoulders and hips.
User asked in one turn whether tiredness after 9 hours of sleep is part of fibro.
User checked whether graded aerobic conditioning means walking, one short exchange.
User said the doctor just gave a diagnosis and sent them home, then asked how to get medications.
User asked how to obtain the medicines and worried about saying the names to the doctor.
User said they were more confused than when they started and their head was spinning.

output.summary: A person told by their doctor that little can be done for fibromyalgia asked whether that is true, whether their morning pain and fatigue are part of it, and whether they will feel this way forever. Three times they asked for plain language, but the bot kept using terms like SNRI, central sensitization and graded aerobic conditioning. The user ended the chat confused and tired, with only a suggestion to ask their doctor about medication and a specialist referral.
